additional_info.body:
Hello Yunus,
Thank you for your quick response.
Based on the photographs provided in the timeline, the issue does not appear to be delamination rather, it seems to be a blackout on the HMI.
It is recommended to update the DLogic Controller and consider replacing the DP cable. Additionally, ensure that there are no loose connections in the Flat Cable. This should hopefully resolve the issue.
